mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, p.name AS promotion_name FROM scm_order_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_promotion p ON p.id = i.promotion_id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO scm_order_item (order_id, material_id, qty, unit_name, unit_ratio, price, tax_rate, amount, tax_amount, done_qty, return_qty, delivery_date, remark, orig_price, promotion_id, gift, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.orderId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.unitName}, #{i.unitRatio}, #{i.price}, #{i.taxRate}, #{i.amount}, #{i.taxAmount}, 0, 0, #{i.deliveryDate}, #{i.remark}, #{i.origPrice}, #{i.promotionId}, COALESCE(#{i.gift}, 0), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_order_item SET done_qty = done_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND qty * (100 + #{overRate}) / 100 - done_qty + replenish_qty >= #{qty}
UPDATE scm_order_item SET return_qty = return_qty + #{qty}, replenish_qty = replenish_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND done_qty - return_qty >= #{qty}
